7303.title: Historical plugin failures override compatible range review
7303.rootCauseOneLine: Historical activation failure incorrectly vetoes a compatible range-upgrade action and takes precedence over its confirmation dialog.

prReviews.verdict: Closed, unmerged; static diff addresses the same restrictions
prReviews.topFinding: No branch code or tests executed; reproduction and fix were authored first.

7303.proposedFix: Let the existing reviewable-range predicate select the Review action and confirmation screen ahead of historical failure while retaining in-range retry and explicit range/version confirmation.
7303.caveats: Component/API-request reproduction only; no live marketplace activation. Screenshots unavailable because the isolated host lacks Chrome and the remote browser cannot access its authenticated share. Full test and sanitized logs are inline in the report.
